svg.title: The stall search's filter: everything movable is transparent
svg.desc: BuildImmobileTrayFilter builds the static obstacle filter for the tray's own footprint with every tray and every AGV in the ignore sets, so that a tray or an AGV standing in the way does not stop the search for a stall. Acceptance of a stall then only asks whether a tray stands on it.
